program:
PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (30e-6, 12e-6, 60e-6),   # OTA tail current
    "gmid1": (15.0, 8.0, 16.0),       # PMOS diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.15, 2.0),
    "gmidp": (6.0, 3.0, 12.0),        # pass device gm/Id at max load
    "Lp":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),
    "K":     (50.0, 20.0, 150.0),     # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "gmid2": (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),        # NMOS gate driver gm/Id at max load
    "L2":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "A1hf":  (6.0, 2.0, 15.0),        # OTA mid/high-frequency gain (sets UGF)
    "fz":    (1e5, 1e4, 5e5),         # lag-lead zero frequency
    "Idiv":  (4e-6, 1e-6, 2e-5),      # feedback divider current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    pi = math.pi
    vin = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); imin = spec.get("iload_min", 1e-4)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 1e-2); CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    beta = vref / vt
    K = p["K"]; Idiv = p["Idiv"]; I1 = p["I1"]; Ib2 = 5e-6

    # ---------------- bias ----------------
    mn0 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mn1 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, Ib2, vds=0.8)
    mpb = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, Ib2, vds=0.9)
    mpt = lut.size("p", 12, 1.0, I1, vds=0.25)

    # ---------------- OTA ----------------
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1 / 2, vds=0.9)   # bulk tied to source
    m3 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, I1 / 2, vds=0.5)
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Ro1 = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A1dc = gm1 * Ro1
    g_hf = gm1 / p["A1hf"] - 1.0 / Ro1
    Rz = 1.0 / max(g_hf, 1e-7)
    Cz = 1.0 / (2 * pi * Rz * p["fz"])

    # ---------------- pass + mirror diode ----------------
    Ih = imax + Idiv; Il = imin + Idiv
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=0.6)
    Wd = max(mp.W / K, 0.42)
    Keff = mp.W / Wd

    # ---------------- driver ----------------
    I2h = Ih / Keff; I2l = Il / Keff
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I2h, vds=0.5)

    def solve_vgs(dev, W, L, Id, vds):
        lo, hi = 0.05, 1.8
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    vgs2h = solve_vgs("n", m2.W, m2.L, I2h, 0.5)
    vgs2l = solve_vgs("n", m2.W, m2.L, I2l, 0.9)
    o2h = lut.op("n", m2.W, m2.L, vgs2h, 0.5); o2l = lut.op("n", m2.W, m2.L, vgs2l, 0.9)
    vgpl = solve_vgs("p", mp.W, mp.L, Il, 0.6)
    opl = lut.op("p", mp.W, mp.L, vgpl, 0.6)
    odh = lut.op("p", Wd, mp.L, mp.vgs, mp.vgs); odl = lut.op("p", Wd, mp.L, vgpl, vgpl)
    Rdiv = vt / Idiv
    Cn1 = m2.cgg + 2 * m3.cgd + m1.cgd

    f = np.logspace(1, 9.7, 4000); s = 2j * pi * f
    def loopT(gm2, gds2, gmp, gdsp, cggp, gmd, gdsd, cggd):
        Z1 = 1.0 / (1.0 / Ro1 + 1.0 / (Rz + 1.0 / (s * Cz)) + s * Cn1)
        Cg = cggp + cggd + 2 * m2.cgd
        Gout = gdsp + 1.0 / Rdiv
        Hg = gm2 / (gmd + gds2 + gdsd + s * Cg)
        T = gm1 * Z1 * Hg * gmp * beta / (Gout + s * CL)
        return T, Gout
    def pm_ugf(T):
        mag = np.abs(T); idx = np.where(mag < 1)[0]
        if len(idx) == 0: return 0.0, f[-1]
        i = idx[0]; ph = np.unwrap(np.angle(T)) * 180 / pi
        return 180 + ph[i], f[i]

    Th, Gh = loopT(o2h["gm"], o2h["gds"], mp.gm, mp.gds, mp.cgg, odh["gm"], odh["gds"], odh["cgg"])
    Tl, Gl = loopT(o2l["gm"], o2l["gds"], opl["gm"], opl["gds"], opl["cgg"], odl["gm"], odl["gds"], odl["cgg"])
    pmh, fuh = pm_ugf(Th); pml, ful = pm_ugf(Tl)

    i1k = np.argmin(np.abs(f - 1e3))
    dI = opl["gds"] + Keff * o2l["gds"] * opl["gm"] / max(Keff * odl["gm"], 1e-12)
    line = dI / (Gl * abs(1 + Tl[0]))
    Hs = dI / abs((Gl + s[i1k] * CL) * (1 + Tl[i1k]))
    dIh = mp.gds + Keff * o2h["gds"]
    Hsh = dIh / abs((Gh + s[i1k] * CL) * (1 + Th[i1k]))
    psrr = -db(max(Hs, Hsh))

    load_reg = abs(vgs2h - vgs2l) / (A1dc * beta) / (imax - imin)
    undershoot = 1.3 * (imax - imin) / (2 * pi * fuh * CL)
    iq = iref + Ib2 + I1 + Idiv + I2l

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MN1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn1)
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    n.dev("MPT", "ns", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpt)
    n.dev("M1A", "d1", "vref", "ns", "ns", m1)
    n.dev("M1B", "n1", "fb", "ns", "ns", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CZ", "nz", "vss", Cz)
    n.dev("M2", "g", "n1", "vss", "vss", m2, m=max(1, int(math.ceil(m2.W / 20))))
    n.M("M5", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, mp.L, m=max(1, int(math.ceil(Wd / 20))))
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=min(200, max(1, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 40)))))
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", (vt - vref) / Idiv)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", vref / Idiv)

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": 0.5,
        "load_reg": load_reg,
        "line_reg": line,
        "psrr_1k": psrr,
        "iq": iq,
        "undershoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": 0.003,
        "pm_heavy_deg": pmh, "ugf_heavy_hz": fuh,
        "pm_light_deg": pml, "ugf_light_hz": ful,
        "vgate_heavy": vin - mp.vgs, "A1dc": A1dc, "Rz": Rz, "Cz": Cz, "Wpass": mp.W,
    }
